name: Выбор пользователя
spec: Three large profile cards with avatar, name, last workout, week activity, Выбрать; distinct Гость action. No profile selected, no misleading personal data. Friendly welcome Выберите профиль. Global safety header but no authenticated sidebar.

name: Главная
spec: Left navigation; greeting Алексей. Main area personal workout cards with duration/exercise count, continue unfinished workout primary, Новая тренировка secondary. Right muscle fatigue front/back map with legend and recommendation. Clear path to workout; no fabricated AI advice or readiness when disconnected.

name: План выбранной тренировки
spec: Selected workout dialog over dashboard, title Силовая тренировка, duration and exercise count, readable five exercise rows with sets/load, compact muscle map. Actions Начать тренировку, Изменить, Назад. STOP remains in visible unobscured global header. No starting real machine from image; demonstrate blocked-start warning Нет связи.

name: Календарь тренировок
spec: History monthly calendar Ноябрь 2026 with previous/next month and Сегодня. Distinguish completed/partial workouts with text + dots. Selected day detail list and summary to right, delete record secondary with confirmation. Not future scheduling editor.

name: Мои тренировки
spec: Workout library: sortable workout cards, Новая тренировка primary, exercise count/duration/group type. Select to edit; no invented marketplace or programs page. Left nav and clear library heading.

name: Редактор тренировки
spec: Workout editor with editable title, group sections and reorder handles, exercise rows with video thumbnail, sets/reps/load/rest. Add exercise, Добавить группу, finish editing and save status. Group modes Обычное/Чередование/Суперсет/Круг. Delete secondary, not bright red main CTA. Detailed selected exercise parameters right; avoid giant unreadable table.

name: Каталог упражнений
spec: Large search Найти упражнение, Все/Избранное tabs; left muscle/equipment filters and reset, results card grid with clear exercise names, video thumbnail, favorite icons, Показать ещё. Primary action open exercise, not start immediately without setup. No duplicated top filter summaries.

name: Карточка упражнения
spec: Жим с пола со штангой details. Video left, overview right with muscles/equipment/difficulty. Tabs Обзор/Техника/Мышцы/Нагрузка/История/Похожие. Video gender and angle selectors. Начать, Добавить в тренировку, favorite, blacklist secondary, back. Starting goes through setup. Large clear main action.

name: Техника упражнения
spec: Exercise details Техника active. Video reference on left; numbered preparation and execution steps on right with brief concise readable Russian text; separate common errors/tips. Preserve full tab bar and primary actions, no unsupported safety coaching claims.

name: Мышцы упражнения
spec: Exercise details Мышцы active: large front/back human muscle diagrams, legend primary/secondary/stabilizers and concise lists. Same title and tabs as details, no anatomical fantasy art; readable scientific diagram rather than photo.

name: Нагрузка и история упражнения
spec: Details Нагрузка active with weight/sets/reps/rest, strength mode and calibration status, small historical load progression chart and past session table. Other tabs available including История. Explicit sample chart period, no duplicate giant numbers.

name: Подготовка и амплитуда
spec: Video left, clear stepwise setup right: weight/sets/reps/rest, set-plan; lower and upper bar endpoints, current mm, hold-to-jog up/down labeled Удерживайте для движения, save endpoint buttons, neutral bar mode. Readiness checklist, disconnected blocked Старт недоступен. Red STOP accessible. Avoid implying arbitrary motion is safe.

name: Настройка фиксированной высоты
spec: Setup fixed-height exercise, one saved height instead of two endpoints. Video, sets/reps/load/rest, current height, hold-to-jog controls, Сохранить высоту, readiness explanation and disabled start if disconnected. Clearly distinguish fixed height from amplitude range.

name: Выполнение упражнения
spec: Faithfully preserve attached approved screen: video LEFT, large reps CENTER, four-set plan RIGHT, far-right position rail; bottom adjustable weight, amplitude/tempo/position metrics and skip/finish. NO two blue weight badges, NO extra amplitude/sync chips below rail. Keep blue theme. This is approved baseline, no rethinking layout.

name: Упражнение на время
spec: Same approved session layout but central counter becomes large 00:32 remaining countdown with цель 00:45. Timer Старт/Пауза/Сброс controls, video left of timed bodyweight exercise, set-plan right. No irrelevant motor position rail if not applicable. Preserve skip/finish and emergency stop.

name: Удержание и настройка грифа
spec: Approved session with clear amber banner Гриф удерживается · повторы не засчитываются. Frozen rep count, explicit Продолжить подход and Настроить положение грифа; open calibration area point selector, hold-to-jog, save point and resume disabled until saved. Do not present movement-enabled hardware as ready without confirmation. STOP fixed and accessible.

name: Отдых между подходами
spec: Large circular rest countdown 01:12 left, pause/continue and +30 секунд. Right next set exercise video and prescription, prior set result, set-plan track. Optional effort/discomfort feedback compact. Начать подход сейчас primary, Завершить тренировку secondary. No duplicate timers.

name: Смена стороны
spec: Rest transition for unilateral movement. Large Правая сторона heading, demonstration right-side setup, clear prior Левая сторона completed summary, next prescription, continue/start action. Direction meaning explicit in text, not color only. No confusing duplicated rest timer.

name: Итог упражнения
spec: Exercise completed heading; concise result metrics, plan versus actual sets table, next load recommendation with reduce/increase controls, recommendation text, Подробно, next exercise primary, finish workout secondary, skipped exercise return option. Show save status, no invented guaranteed fitness outcomes.

name: Итог тренировки
spec: Workout completed summary, duration/sets/reps/volume, completed exercise list, partial exercise follow-up option, next load controls in details, save status/retry, muscle fatigue small chart. На главную primary, Подробно and Усталость и восстановление secondary. Celebratory blue subtle, not confetti over text.

name: Прогресс — обзор
spec: Tabs Обзор/Сила/Тело/Фото, periods 7 дней/30 дней/3 месяца/6 месяцев/Год/Всё. Clear volume chart with axis units, workout frequency heatmap, records, recommendations and load balance. Achievements link. Use few legible charts, no dense fake dashboard.

name: Прогресс силы
spec: Сила active; exercise picker Жим с пола, period filter, one dominant load progression chart with kg/date axes, record and volume summaries, session history table, option show exercises outside selected period. Consistent tabs.

name: Тело и измерения
spec: Тело active: weight trend kg with dates, scale connection status, body measurement list and open selected metric chart. Add measurement dialog with date, metric, value unit and save/cancel. Explicit no scale connection; no medical diagnosis.

name: Фотопрогресс
spec: Фото active: dated gallery, front/side/back filters, take photo, choose two dates to compare, delete with confirmation. Neutral clothed adult fitness progress thumbnails not sexualized, privacy-aware layout no public sharing. Do not add social network functions.

name: Сравнение фотографий
spec: Two equal side-by-side dated photos same angle and framing with date pickers, angle selector and back. Neutral adult in opaque fitness clothing. Clear comparison controls no fabricated body analysis. Keep navigation and global safety header.

name: Достижения
spec: Achievement collection stats and Все/Новые/Полученные/Неизвестные tabs, search, category/rarity filters, grid. Badges are pointed-up HEXAGONS with narrow saturated beveled rim and dark inset, not circular medals. Locked badges conceal identity with question mark; avoid invented secret text disclosure.

name: Карточка достижения
spec: Unlocked hexagonal achievement large illustration left; name, earned date and progression right with all tier milestones, play voice button, back to achievements. Locked future tiers conceal text; no crown/diamond footer ornaments. No share/social actions absent in app.

name: Усталость и восстановление
spec: Large front/back muscle map left, readable fatigue legend. Right Состояние мышц, Рекомендуется сегодня, Под наблюдением, Рекомендация Forma, choose workout/calendar actions. Reset fatigue secondary confirmation. Explain data is training estimation not medical diagnosis; no safety guarantees.

name: Профиль
spec: Avatar, name Алексей, age/height/weight/BMI and goal, Редактировать. Tabs Обзор/Измерения/Фото/Ограничения. Overview recent measurements, photo thumbnails, workout timeline. Avoid excessive duplicate personal metrics across panels.

name: Редактирование и ограничения
spec: Profile editing form name/date of birth/height/weight/notes/goal and numeric target with explicit units. Save/cancel. Restrictions tab visible behind with excluded exercises and remove restriction actions. Private notes no real personal data; sample fields.

name: Настройки
spec: Tabs Обзор/Безопасность/Общие/AI-тренер/Сервис. Overview machine readiness, recent events, calibrations, quick actions. User-friendly labels for ordinary settings, separate operator service section, no fabricated ready status. Use status Нет связи with explanation.

name: Безопасность
spec: Safety settings child protection, launch/service PIN masked, guest mode, auto-lock, load/speed/desync limits with units, desync reaction. Save/cancel/default. Emergency reset secondary confirmed action with conditions, not prominent casual button. STOP global always available; never display PIN digits.

name: Общие настройки
spec: Theme/scale/language/units, brightness, auto-return, sound/voice volume, connection and version/serial. Clear grouped settings sections, blue selected controls, save/cancel where existing. No duplicate technical settings or giant chart.

name: AI-тренер
spec: Coach enable and consent, local/cloud mode, cloud budget USD, privacy memory/delete memory, speech frequency, rep counting, during-set/rest speech, voice and volume, character/style/person name/context. Group dense options in logical sections, one save footer, no API keys or tokens shown.

name: Сервис
spec: Clearly operator-only service panel, service-mode status and servo OFF statuses, positions and drive health, diagnostics, calibration links, journal. Dangerous enable/reset actions require confirmation and prerequisites. Show disconnected/disabled realistic state. Global emergency stop, warning software STOP does not replace physical emergency stop.

name: Modbus — диагностика
spec: Professional operator screen, driver selector, tabs Подключение/Диагностика/Параметры/Управление/Мониторинг/Ошибки/Журнал/Сохранение. Connection diagnostic panel with left/right status, registers readouts and explicit units, connect/disconnect/read actions. No secrets, no claims hardware connected. Warning software stop not physical emergency protection.

name: Параметры приводов
spec: Same service shell and full tabs; searchable register table name/address/current/edit/unit, changed-only filter, read and write-changes actions, save EEPROM separately confirmed. Editing disabled disconnected. No invented drive register addresses; generic dash placeholders acceptable.

name: Мониторинг приводов
spec: Same service tabs, monitoring plots position/speed/torque with units and left/right legend, time axis. Disconnected state has empty plots/no incoming data rather than fake live measurements. Start monitoring disabled; read-only diagnosis, errors/journal links. STOP visible.

name: Калибровки приводов
spec: Operator calibration catalog and prerequisite checklist, dependency sequence, left/right drive statuses, selected step explanation, start disabled until prerequisites met. Tabs Калибровки/Параметры. Service and servo controls explicit disabled disconnected. No contradictory hold instructions for automated calibration; no invented safe limits.

name: Результат калибровки
spec: Recorded calibration result not live: report timestamp, step stages, position/force plots units, proposed old/new parameter table, Сохранить новые значения or Отклонить with confirmation. History list, global STOP, no auto-apply or safety gate bypass.

name: Профиль параметров
spec: Profile version, search, provenance filters Все/Измерено/Вручную/Не измерено, parameter table with units/origin/edit fields. Save and separate dangerous reset calibration/reset settings/reset all actions requiring confirmations. Unknown values dash, no guessed machine parameters.

name: Аварийная остановка
spec: Emergency overlay on approved session, red status Тренировка остановлена, explicit Движение заблокировано. Clear explanation inspect equipment and follow actual reset prerequisites, no one-click auto restart. Existing finish-as-interrupted action, reset safety separately if available. Red STOP remains accessible and no blue continuation while stop active. Background readable but inactive.
